parts: Female born on November 26, 1997. HD: A-A. Shoulder height: 56 cm. ACABE Sociability test: PASSED.

Thaila represents part of the culmination of the Larrywood kennel's breeding work. From the cross of Fardón de Larrywood (son of Shakespeare) and Lucy de Larrywood (litter sister of Shakespeare), closely linebred through English lines to Barnolby Troubles Hooter at Oldoak.
She arrived home on January 3, 1998. She soon began to show signs of what she would become.

She is a very typical and elegant female, small and feminine, with excellent angulation, head and neck and a high-quality coat. Her movement is very typical of the breed. She has abundant pigmentation around her dark brown eyes.

Her first appearance in the ring in Open Class was in León in September 1998 at the age of 22 months, under the prestigious specialist judge Mr. Stuart Mallard, placing Excellent 2 RCAC RCACIB. She appears in the ring only occasionally, and one of her notable results was in Madrid (Autumn'00), Excellent 2 RCAC RCACIB.
She is the mother of our litters C, E and G.
